notes:
AlpeHuez v0.8.0
- Restore from the system tray now opens the normal windowed interface instead of fullscreen.
- Clicking the Windows taskbar icon now restores the AlpeHuez window reliably without freezing or requiring Task Manager.
- Window resize is available again, including native edge handles.
- Win+Left and Win+Right now snap AlpeHuez correctly to the left or right half of the desktop.
- Alt+Tab now shows AlpeHuez as a normal application window.
- The My Files password prompt now uses the same centered login card style as the Developer Panel.
